image.title: Cangrande I della Scala
image.creator: Borde Carlo
image.attribution: Borde Carlo, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
image.why: The lord of Verona who sheltered Dante in exile

summary.en: Lord of Verona from 1308 (sole ruler from 1311) and leader of the Ghibellines in northern Italy, who took Vicenza, Padua and Treviso. He was Dante's leading patron during his exile.

en: Christened Can Francesco; his name means 'big dog'
